Test Case 5: Performance improvement verification

Input: Measure template loading time

Expected Output:
- Load time under 100ms: true
- No filesystem I/O: true

Validation Logic:
1. Record start time
2. Call BootstrapTemplates.loadAll()
3. Record end time
4. Calculate total load time
5. Verify load time is under 100ms
6. Confirm no filesystem I/O occurred (embedded imports are in-memory)

Success Criteria:
- Templates load in under 100ms (typically <10ms)
- No filesystem operations performed
- Performance is faster than previous filesystem-based approach

Benchmark Context:
- Previous implementation: ~50-200ms (filesystem reads + JSON parsing)
- New implementation: <10ms (in-memory access only)
- Expected improvement: 5-20x faster
